subtitle: One Voice at the Valley Mouth
briefing: Merek’s household veterans hold the open valley mouth. The packs and Old Root now fight together under Ash-Muzzle. Break the chief and his army to end the occupation. Forest patches and the northern ridge offer cover, while the southern marsh ford gives the wolves a longer flank.

intro.text: Yara hides behind beasts while another keeper wears her quarrel. Come forward, Ash-Muzzle. I will settle both debts.
Yara does not command me. You brought your spears onto our feeding grounds. Now every den you threatened stands against you.
My brother meant to clear that grove. I will finish his road, and take the valley he should have lived to see.

dialogue.text: The old tree can take their arrows. Keep it clear of the swordsman and that hammer. Their healer will keep those men standing unless we bring him down.

alternative.text: The old tree can take their arrows. Keep it clear of the swordsman and that hammer. Bring down their healer before he mends our work.

dialogue.text: The rider is looking for our thorncallers. I will cover them. Send the wolves round once his foot soldiers commit.

alternative.text: Keep shields beside the thorncallers. Hold their cavalry while our wolves go round the fighting.

intro.text: Pack, grove and thorn together. Break Merek’s army. We will not leave his spears on this side of the valley.

victory.text: Merek is dead. His army is broken. Leave the village to its people; we take the southern ford home.

dialogue.text: At the pasture I promised you a hearing. You have my den now, Ash-Muzzle, and my shield.

alternative.speaker: The pack speakers
alternative.text: Sedge pledged his den to this road. We will keep that pledge. We follow Ash-Muzzle.

dialogue.text: And Old Root’s thorns. One call, when the valley needs us.

alternative.speaker: The grove-dwellers
alternative.text: Old Root follows the packs. One call, when the valley needs us.

victory.text: One call, then. But we answer together. Keep the young close while we cross.

debrief: Merek’s army is gone. The woodland folk leave by the marsh ford as one company under Ash-Muzzle. The packs and Old Root keep their own homes, but now answer one call when their feeding grounds are threatened.
